QuestInfo.name: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Fairynappers
QuestInfo.0: Fanzy the cat, one of Grendel the Really Old's pupils, would like your help in the North Forest's Giant Tree.
QuestInfo.1: Fanzy the cat wants you to go to the Ellinel Fairy Academy. You can find the entrance at the bottom of the North Forest Giant Tree.
QuestInfo.2: Fanzy has a favor to ask. Go to the Lake in front of the Ellinel Fairy Academy for details.

0.msg: We already know each other, but I'll introduce myself again. My name is #bFanzy#k. I may be just a cat, but I'm #bGrendel the Really Old's#k top student. And am I REALLY just a cat? Meow.

1.msg: It wasn't easy, no-siree. It takes dedication and smarts.\r\nYou can bask in #bmy glory#k if you'd like.

2.msg: Sure, sure. I'll look up to you. But did you see any #bstrangers#k in Ellinel?

3.msg: Maybe they're from your world. No wonder I felt a #bdifferent aura#k from them. I won't stop you from looking for them.\r\nMeow? What was I talking about? Meow! This isn't the time for this!

4.msg: #fNpc/1500011.img/stand/0#\r\nIf you're overwhelmed by the sheer magnitude of my amazingness, I'd recommend talking to #bCootie the Really Small#k. He's another of Grendel's pupils, but his bulb isn't quite so bright.

5.msg: #fNpc/1500000.img/stand/0##fNpc/1500002.img/stand/0#\r\nHe's been a little bit of a weirdo since those fairies captured him. I've heard he even took to #e#rkidnapping fairies#k#n of his own... Can't say I blame him, they're so fun to bat around.

6.msg: Help me or don't. I've got plenty of grooming myself to do...

yes.0: There's a secret path down below that the fairies just seem to love. I bet there's something deliciously fun to do in there...\r\n(#bNorth Forest: Take the bottom tunnel in the Giant Tree to reach #bEllinel Lake Shore#k.)
What kind of pupil will you be if you're this slow to walk somewhere?

npc.0: Do you see the tunnel there? That's the path the fairies take into the forest. Go have a look...\r\n#b(Travel down the Ellinel Lake Shore to get to the Fairy Academy.)#k
